reasons: The eight raw pinned artifacts match every SHA-256 selector in this exact R_binding scope. The v2 warrants and operation specification also match their scoped digests. I independently recomputed the native canonical contract, candidate, source-list, fixture, receipt and package-key identities; they agree with the verified manifest and receipt. The retained original native attempt matches the copies being reviewed.

The candidate collector source is byte-identical to the source pinned in the baseline, operator and v2 request packages (collector.py SHA-256 9e21aef378515309a3eb5b0e0265b6cefebe32194c4f20cca82f19be55504775). Their five native package file pins agree. The operator generation configuration migrates to the exact exported runtime profile under the public schema-2-to-schema-1 rule; the operation purpose and schemas follow the public parameterised-operation and collection-carrier translations. These are accounted-for transformations, not contradictory identities.

The runtime profile and exported package pin image sha256:5d317440653dd5a188223baff22644397cc2a1bd071183a12e9c4cb2f3688f7f, disable runtime networking and supply no inherited tool environment. The retained image inspection identifies that immutable image, and the preparation receipt and actual offline API smoke identify installed pgmpy 1.1.2. All four image recipe/profile hashes still match that receipt. Independently of copied labels, the reviewed collector rejects any installed pgmpy distribution version other than 1.1.2 and invokes its public Bayesian-network, CPD and variable-elimination APIs; the reviewed native package loader replaces the run profile image with the immutable package pin and checks the admitted runner image identity.

The native verification receipt reports twelve successful cases, including the selected input, changed evidence, changed parameters, malformed protocol, invalid input and zero evidence mass. Its hashes bind those cases to this candidate, contract, fixtures, runner and image. The public native implementation record reports two constructor model calls, no deferred operation and a matching package-manifest pin; the retained command receipt records exit code zero. These are bounded software qualification records, not evidence of external hardware adequacy.

The pinned host record is byte-identical to baseline/execution.json, and its selected observation equals the original native SQLite observation. That observation has status ok, returncode 0 and untruncated output, with posterior_fault 0.756218905472637, evidence_normalizer 0.0201 and calculation_complete true. Reconstructing the known successful observation envelope reproduces both its recorded 641-byte stdout length and stdout digest.

I recomputed the host input, full-request, acquisition-request and data digests. They match the observation. Its model parameters and selected evidence equal the v2 acquisition arguments; its returned acquisition context equals the original baseline export context 83fc7f7bab873f49e4fc73bc3f31b4b8f5a57d32a94c552d65a3847dd0d97631. I also reproduced the recorded native tool-binding HMAC from the exact baseline binding configuration and local private store key without printing or retaining that key. The later review request has its own export context 11c47113ad188dba192f130e40b4cd9ca08fb59687b851e8b756de61e87d39b7; this review does not relabel the historical execution as having that later context.

All fourteen frozen EAL executable hashes and both frozen EngArg executable hashes match their manifests. The recorded generation binaries match EngArg 5dd35355fd10c1a1574822073d08790978709b4925fe4d2640a49492a448c813, EAL host 0c88669ed43bb3162d7fb69a1afe9259bb47d695085a4a8f80a50e88fbf63350 and EAL tool runner 64f90430f0eed728a13e3d4f194ad19a955106c7bca372e80cabee123eb283a6. The retained EAL runtime receipt identifies revision 030d4514e9c5e01c95690e0d921a5da2cf6525af, and the proposed report selects the same frozen host.

The execution clock remains the original collected_at 2026-10-28T15:39:22.773512Z, with original started_at 15:38:50.156072Z and ingested_at 15:39:25.258906Z retained. The collector obtains observed_at from its UTC clock after calculation; the native package requires an original valid UTC timestamp. This judgement uses the actual current reviewed_at below, not an earlier fabricated review time. At judgement the original execution age is 1073.475083 seconds, within the explicit 86400-second consumer limit. Reuse must retain and re-evaluate these original clocks rather than refresh them.

Support is bounded to this local, operator-authorised native provenance chain. It assumes the local host, Docker daemon, frozen executables, installed image contents, pgmpy and other libraries, private run store and UTC clock behaved as recorded. Local hashes and the store-key HMAC establish correspondence under those assumptions; they do not provide remote attestation, independent clock certification, package correctness proofs or external model validity. A copied image/runtime label alone would not support this verdict.

This is an actual scoped AI review of retained artifacts and source, performed by a separate task agent in the same shared AI session as the implementation/qualification work. I received parent summaries and shared task history and used the same filesystem and runtime receipts. It is not a blind or organisationally independent review, human approval, institutional attestation, or a review of other criteria. I ran no Docker workload, provider inference, compiler or collector and changed no collector or evidence artifact during this review.
